subtitle: Global Intelligent Communication Lab (GIC-Lab)
mission: We advance intelligent, secure, and resilient communication technologies that connect people and communities across terrestrial, aerial, and space networks.
about: The Global Intelligent Communication (GIC) Laboratory conducts cutting-edge research on next-generation communication systems. Our work spans satellite communications, high-altitude platform stations (HAPS), low-altitude networks for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and flying vehicles, 6G technologies, and evolving Wi-Fi systems. We seek to develop robust, intelligent, and highly adaptable communication infrastructure by integrating AI-driven optimization, advanced wireless protocols, and scalable global network architectures. We also address societal challenges by improving connectivity in underserved areas, building disaster-resilient networks, and developing communication platforms that can respond to rapidly changing global and local needs. Based in Kochi Prefecture, Japan, the GIC Laboratory connects global research ambitions with regional innovation. We use advanced communication technologies to support regional revitalization, smart communities, and environmental sustainability while pursuing academic excellence and meaningful social impact.
